lines.en: I walk steady on all fours.
My gold armor flashes once in the light.
My head rides low, ready to charge.
I tread the fallen leaves of the birch wood.
I follow the old prints on the game trail.
One sweep of my tail clears the leaves.
I step around birch roots.
My four legs cycle fast.

lines.zh: 我的爪子收着，落地才露。
lines.en: Claws tucked, shown only on landing.
I come out from the trees into the open.
I stop and shake my head.
I walk a lap of the game trail.
I stand, my gold armor still.

lines.zh: 我在白桦林里有自己的位置。
lines.en: I have my place in this birch wood.
I'm a Perfect-level.
My name is GoldV-dramon.
I wait for prey to show.
I lift a leg and scrape the soil.
A gold horn rides on my head.
Only when the wood goes quiet do I relax.

lines.zh: 我在听林子里细小的声音。
lines.en: I listen to the fine sounds of the wood.

lines.zh: 我侧耳，听落叶下的动静。
lines.en: I tilt an ear to the sound under the leaves.

lines.zh: 这一片白桦，是我熟的路。
lines.en: These birches are a road I know.
Something else has walked this dirt.
I don't need much sleep.
My prints are deep.
This path is closed today.
This gold stands out.
You're not what I'm looking for.
Better keep that hand where it is.
I bring my head level with yours.
I can run fast.

lines.zh: 这片林子没有你的味道。
lines.en: This wood holds no scent of you.
There's no retreat behind me.
Is that a bow in your hand?
I stand and watch how close you dare come.
This won't be light.
Don't circle behind me.
Next time we meet, I'll know you.
Once you're gone, I nose the ground.
Your armor won't stop a charge.
My horn is only low, not charging.
A scratch on my gold armor.
My hind leg braces; I stay up.
That hit my shoulder.
The growl stays low in my throat.
I shake my armor and set my stance.
These four legs can still run.
I guard my chest with a claw.
This will heal.
You aimed for the seam in my armor.
That one dented my armor.
Is that meat in your hand?
I step closer, one pace at a time.

lines.zh: 肉味压过了落叶的味道。
lines.en: Meat overpowers the smell of fallen leaves.
Lower it to elbow height and I can reach.
Not enough to fill me.
Hold your hand steady.
One bite and it's gone.
Bring me another portion.
This tastes good.
I don't risk myself for one meal.

lines.zh: 我抬头，鼻孔对着你的手。
lines.en: I raise my head, nostrils toward your hand.
Step back, and I'll lower my head.
You hit me and I don't yield.
My gold armor stings your hand.
I turn and my tail catches you.
You hit me and stagger to the roots.
I lower myself and hold.
You run headlong into my armor plate.

lines.zh: 这一下，我知道你的力气。
lines.en: Now I know your strength.
I turn aside to let your path through.
The impact rings crisp.
Again and I'll move.
Another one is in the birches too.
It takes the left, I take the right.
Its gold is paler than mine.
We patrol the border together.
Our kind need few words.
It sniffs me first.
We each turn away.
Its prints run beside mine.
Before dark, it leaves first.
Next time, maybe by the river.

lines.zh: 我用牙把它从土里挑出。
lines.en: My teeth pry it out of the dirt.
I clamp a claw on it.
That much won't do for me.
I kick it into the leaves.
I check every drop.
The pearl rolls to my claw.
I snap it up and taste it.
I'm not carrying this.
This won't feed me; I toss it.
It hampers my running.

lines.zh: 你的侧面空着，我看到了。
lines.en: Your flank is open; I see it.
I lower my shoulders and load my hind legs.
This charge is fast.
When you give ground, my feet advance.
My claws bite the ground.
You can't stop this one.
I've fixed on your flank.
You have a single step of room.
No circling; I aim straight at you.
I don't roar. I charge.
Your footing isn't set.
I've already started moving.
Behind a tree. Too thin.
I run the treeline.
My claws land quietly.
You change course; I cut across.
Your tracks give you away.
No hurry. My legs are long.
The slope is steep. My footing slips.
I come up from lower ground.
Your panting carries down.
One more step closer.
You're in the open. Good.
I flatten down, ready to spring.
I lunge and slam you.
My gold horn hits your shield.
That flips you over.
My horn punches through your shoulder guard.
You're four steps back.
I hit your waist from the side.

lines.zh: 这一下带着我全部的跑势。
lines.en: That carried my whole run.
I knocked your guard wide.
I close my teeth and wrench sideways.
You drop, and I come again.
I held nothing back.
The gold dust on you is mine.

lines.zh: 我从白桦林深处走出来。
lines.en: I come out of the deep birches.

lines.zh: 金甲在叶影里闪了一下。
lines.en: Gold flashes among the leaf shadows.
First I lowered my head.
The first thing I see is birches.
I shake the leaves off my back.
My prints stay in the soil.
Leaves spiral at my feet.

lines.zh: 林子里有脚步，不是我的。
lines.en: Footsteps in the wood, and they're not mine.
I walk half a circle of the clearing.
I rise from between the birch roots.
The birches are quiet.

lines.zh: 我先在原地站了一会儿。
lines.en: I stand in place a moment first.
Fire over my gold. It burns hot.

lines.zh: 从高处下来，膝重重一屈。
lines.en: Coming down hard, my knees buckle.
I kick at the water; my armor drags me down.

lines.zh: 轰鸣过后，我耳朵一片嗡。
lines.en: After the blast, my ears ring flat.

lines.zh: 一支箭卡进我的金甲缝。
lines.en: An arrow jams in my armor's seam.

lines.zh: 那道光把我四条腿捆住。
lines.en: That light lashes my four legs together.
Hunger slows my run.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，金甲都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning hits; my armor lights up.
I fall, paws grasping nothing.
